init_model_weights: init a PyTorch neural network model with orthogonal weight initialization and optional noise injection
orthogonalize_weights: orthogonalize a PyTorch weight tensor using QR decomposition and return orthogonalized weights
get_eigenvalues: get the eigenvalues of a PyTorch weight tensor for analyzing spectral properties
get_correlation: get the flattened correlation values of a PyTorch weight matrix
convert_weights_to_matrix: convert n-dimensional PyTorch weights to a 2D matrix for linear algebra operations
